intentions: Allow customers to place orders with multiple products
Manage product categories and product stock levels
Track order status (pending, confirmed, shipped, cancelled)
Reserve stock when confirming an order and release it when cancelling a confirmed order
Enable customers to search for their orders and invoices
Allow administrators to add, edit, and remove products and categories
Expose core operations via a command-line interface (CLI)
Validate user input to ensure data integrity
Handle errors gracefully with clear user feedback
Separate business logic from data persistence layers
Maintain a modular and maintainable code structure
